{{Quote|This is Major Sanos, just off his third year at the Trench.|Major Nedecca|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Sanos''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[3640 BBY]], after his third year at the [[Trench (Folor)|Trench]], he was assigned to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] under [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Razer]] and participated in the [[Battle of Corellia]] offensives such as an assault on the [[Aegis Base]] together with [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Nedecca]] and former Intelligence Agent [[Cipher Nine]].<ref name="TOR" />
